Senior Director, Information Technology
jobs.description:
Vacancy Status
: Full Time, 14 Month Contract 

Position Description:
The Toronto Region Board of Trade is seeking a Senior Director, Information Technology for a 14-month contract to lead the Board's IT team. Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer, you will ensure the Board's systems remain secure, reliable and well-supported, and serve as a trusted technology partner across all levels of the organization. This role oversees IT operations, business applications, vendor partnerships, cybersecurity and in-flight technology initiatives within a Microsoft-centred environment that includes Azure, Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365 and the Power Platform. In addition to progressive IT leadership experience, the ideal candidate will be a clear communicator, highly collaborative, and able to step into an established environment quickly, combining sound strategic judgment with a hands-on approach to day-to-day operations.

Key Responsibilities:
Technology Leadership & Execution

Serves as the senior technology advisor to the Chief Financial Officer and leadership team, providing clear, concise updates and recommendations.

Ensures technology priorities remain aligned with organizational goals and carries forward in-flight initiatives to agreed milestones.

Maintains a strong understanding of the organization’s technology environment and remains actively involved in the execution and resolution of day-to-day technology matters.

Identifies opportunities to improve technology effectiveness, reliability and user experience, with a focus on practical solutions appropriate for a 50-100-person organization.

AI Implementation & Adoption

Supports the implementation of agentic AI solutions across the organization, working with business teams and external partners to identify practical use cases, configure and test solutions, and integrate them into everyday workflows.

Manages and supports the Board’s AI tools, including Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini, overseeing licensing, access, configuration and technical support.

Coordinates the technical requirements for AI implementation, including system integrations, data access, testing and deployment, ensuring appropriate security controls and human oversight in accordance with the Board’s AI use policy.

Provides practical guidance, training and troubleshooting to help employees adopt AI tools and apply them effectively in their work.

Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

Leads, supports and develops the IT team, setting priorities and managing performance and KPIs.

Provides service to all areas of the Board by applying business partner skills and a client service outlook.

Allocates work effectively across the team and ensures appropriate coverage for operational priorities, projects and employee support.

Documents key decisions and changes to support a smooth transition at the end of the contract

Vendor Management, Security & Compliance

Manages the relationships with key technology partners, including the managed services providers; monitors performance and oversees renewals and negotiations.

Leads vendor escalations and ensures unresolved service issues are addressed quickly and effectively.

Maintains the Board's cybersecurity posture across Azure and Microsoft 365, including identity, access and data protection.

Upholds IT policies, including the Board's AI use policy, and supports compliance with accessibility (AODA) and privacy requirements.

IT Operations & Service Delivery

Oversees the reliable day-to-day operation of IT infrastructure and technology services at both the Board’s event space at 100 Queens Quay and corporate office at 21 Melinda, including network connectivity, Wi-Fi, end-user services, collaboration tools and telephony.

Takes a hands-on role in addressing operational issues, troubleshooting escalated concerns and coordinating resolution with internal team members and external vendors.

Manages the IT operating calendar, including renewals, reviews and as needed event support.

Maintains service levels and resolves escalated issues promptly.

Oversees technology onboarding and offboarding, hardware and software provisioning, access management and equipment lifecycle requirements.

Business Applications & Data

Oversees the Board's infrastructure including: CRM, marketing automation, finance, event management system, payments, website and related platforms.

Works directly with business teams and vendors to troubleshoot issues, manage enhancements and ensure systems are configured to support operational requirements.

Coordinates system upgrades, integrations, implementations and changes, ensuring appropriate testing, communication, documentation and employee support.

Supports reporting and analytics through Power BI and champions low-code solutions on the Power Platform where they add value.

Identifies opportunities to automate manual processes, simplify workflows and improve productivity using existing technology.

Your experience includes:

10+ years of progressive IT experience, including experience leading IT teams.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Strong working knowledge of a Microsoft-centred environment, including Azure, Microsoft 365 and Dynamics 365.

Practical experience implementing or supporting AI tools and workflow automation, including technical deployment and employee adoption; experience with agentic AI solutions considered an asset.

Experience managing IT infrastructure, connectivity, audiovisual systems and technology support across multiple locations, including corporate office and event environments.

Proven experience managing managed service providers and external agencies, including contracts and performance.

Solid grounding in cybersecurity practices for a cloud-first organization.

Experience managing an IT budget and reporting to senior executives.

Strong oral and written communication skills; experience explaining technical matters to partners at all levels.

Ability to work cross-functionally and collaboratively with business units.

Experience with Business Central, Power BI, ClickDimensions, CMS considered an asset.

You’re often described as:

A steady, pragmatic leader who builds trust quickly with a new team

A business partner first, able to translate organizational needs into practical technology solutions

Highly organized and able to navigate competing priorities and deadlines

A self-starter who can work independently from a structured handover

A strong communicator, collaborative with colleagues from all levels and departments

Security-minded, detail-oriented and accountable

Working Conditions:

Full-time position, hybrid with 3-4 days in office.

May require occasional evening and weekend work for system maintenance or emergencies.

On-call availability for critical system issues.

Compensation & Benefits

TRBOT is committed to fair, equitable pay that matches the responsibility and expertise behind every role.

This role has an annual salary range of $120,000-$170,000.

At TRBOT, performance plays an important role in pay progression. As you build your skills, take on new challenges, and make an impact, your compensation will evolve to reflect that progress. Regular development check-ins with your manager keep your path clear and your momentum strong.

We encourage open dialogue about compensation at every stage of the interview proto ensure transparency and trust. Ask us anything—we want you to feel informed and confident from day one.

About the Toronto Region Board of Trade

At Toronto Region Board of Trade, you work closely with a collaborative, results-driven team of city builders. You will be centre stage on the issues that matter to the region. Working at Toronto Region Board of Trade gives you an opportunity to work with thought leaders, while collaborating with our dynamic, diverse membership.

Our culture is grounded in core values that include:

Accountability – We are accountable to our Members, stakeholders and each other.

Collaboration – We are our strongest when we work together.

Connections – We engage and build communities.

Learn more about the exciting work the Board is doing at bot.com.

We look forward to hearing from interested candidates. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

The Board welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodation is available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

As part of our recruitment process, TRBOT may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support the screening of applications. Participation is optional, and candidates can choose to opt out as part of the application process.

jobs.description:
Embark on a rewarding career with Sobeys Inc., celebrated among Canada’s Top 100 employers where your unique contributions drive success.

Role Summary

The Director, Digital Experience Platforms (DXP) is accountable for the strategy, engineering delivery, operations, reliability, and evolution of all customer-facing digital experience platforms across Empire banners. This role leads the technology execution of web, mobile, content, search, UX platform capabilities, and front-end engineering ecosystems, ensuring seamless, scalable, secure, and high-performing customer experiences.

The Director serves as the primary technology counterpart to Digital Experience, Digital Product, Customer Engagement, Commerce, and Banner teams, translating business vision into enterprise-grade digital capabilities. The role is responsible for balancing innovation, delivery velocity, operational excellence, and platform sustainability while enabling a product-led operating model.

Accountabilities & Responsibilities

Digital Experience Platform Leadership

Own the end-to-end technology strategy, roadmap, delivery, and operation of all digital experience platforms across web, mobile, and customer-facing digital channels.
Define the future-state architecture and capability evolution roadmap for DXP technologies including Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), front-end platforms, mobile applications, search technologies, design systems, and supporting digital services.
Ensure platform capabilities support enterprise digital commerce objectives, customer experience strategies, and banner-specific priorities.
Establish technology standards, engineering practices, and governance frameworks for front-end and customer experience platforms.

Engineering Delivery & Execution

Lead multiple engineering teams responsible for:
Customer websites
Mobile applications
Front-end engineering
Search and discovery platforms
Design systems
Content delivery platforms
AEM ecosystem

Drive delivery of strategic initiatives through Agile product teams.
Ensure predictable execution, release readiness, and high-quality software delivery.
Partner with Product and Business teams to define roadmaps, priorities, and release strategies.
Govern delivery performance, release quality, technical debt management, and modernization initiatives.

Digital Experience Reliability & Operations

Own availability, performance, scalability, and resilience of all digital experience platforms.
Establish operational excellence standards for:
Incident management
Production support
Monitoring and observability
Disaster recovery
Capacity planning

Lead major incident response and continuous service improvement initiatives.
Ensure regulatory, privacy, accessibility, and security compliance requirements are embedded within platform delivery.

UX Technology & Experience Enablement

Own the technology ecosystem that enables experience delivery, including:
Design systems
Component libraries
Content management capabilities
Front-end frameworks

Partner with UX and CX teams to ensure customer experience strategies are translated into scalable technology solutions.
Build strong alignment between design intent and engineering execution.
Enable consistency across banners while balancing local business needs.

Platform Modernization & Innovation

Champion modern engineering practices including:
Headless architecture
API-first development
Component-driven development
DevOps and CI/CD
Cloud-native architecture

Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends to continuously improve customer experiences.
Drive platform simplification and technology rationalization to reduce complexity and improve speed-to-market.

Leadership Responsibilities

Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of managers, architects, Analysts and Developers.
Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, customer obsession, and operational excellence.
Build succession plans and talent development strategies for key digital capabilities.
Establish clear ownership and measurable outcomes across engineering and platform teams.
Create an environment focused on collaboration, continuous improvement, and execution excellence.

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related discipline.
Master's degree considered an asset.

Experience

12+ years of progressive experience leading large-scale digital engineering organizations.
Proven experience managing customer-facing digital platforms at enterprise scale.
Experience leading large Agile product and engineering teams.
Strong background in digital commerce, customer experience, or omnichannel retail environments.

Technical Expertise

Adobe Experience Manager (AEM)
Headless and composable architectures
React / Next.js ecosystems
Mobile application platforms (iOS and Android)
API and microservices architecture
Search and discovery technologies
Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
DevOps and CI/CD practices
UX design systems and front-end architectures

Who We Are

Sobeys is one of Canada’s leading grocery retailers, with more than 1,600 stores across all 10 provinces and banners including Sobeys, Safeway, IGA, Foodland, FreshCo, Thrifty Foods, and Lawtons Drug Stores. Our 128,000 teammates and franchise affiliates are passionate about delivering great food and exceptional experiences to our customers and communities.

Depending on role and eligibility, teammates may receive health and dental benefits, retirement and savings programs including an Employee Share Ownership Plan, a 10% in-store discount at participating banners, virtual healthcare and an Employee and Family Assistance Program, learning and development opportunities, parental leave top-up, and paid vacation.

jobs.description:
Director of Marketing — Job Description

MedixSafe | Full-Time | Reports to the President

This role is hybrid and will require you to work in office up to 3 days per week.

About MedixSafe

MedixSafe provides secure medication storage and narcotics tracking for EMS agencies, fire departments, hospitals, and healthcare organizations. Our intelligent security hardware and cloud software help organizations store, track, and audit controlled substances safely and in compliance with regulatory requirements.

New DEA regulations are changing how EMS agencies handle controlled substances, and our newest product extension delivers vial-level tracking without disrupting medic workflow. We are scaling, and we need a marketing leader to make MedixSafe the category leader in controlled substance compliance and inventory intelligence.

The Role

The Director of Marketing owns MedixSafe's marketing strategy, pipeline generation, and category positioning, and is accountable for marketing's contribution to revenue. You will turn regulatory change and operational risk into messaging that drives demand from enterprise EMS agencies, fire departments, and healthcare systems.

This is a hands-on leadership role in a lean team.
You will work directly with the President and Sales, and lead a Marketing Coordinator who you will share day-to-day execution and marketing operations (the Coordinator also supports Customer Activation). AI is central to how we operate: we use tools like Claude daily and expect you to build a function that does more with less.

What You'll Own

Market recognition as the leader in controlled substance compliance.
